rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Every pronoun/demonstrative resolves in-chunk or against an already-earned same-file term: chunk 0 L5 'it runs...That's a project' resolves to the just-named Lemmings game; chunk 1 L9 'That's the point' resolves to the prior sentence; chunk 1 L10/L12 'the game' reuses the chunk-0 lede noun (carve-out, not a violation); chunk 1 L13 'the page' resolves to 'the `.html`' two lines above in the same chunk; chunk 2 L17 'the game' reuses the arc term; chunk 3 L23 'the prework' names a document, not a pronoun; chunk 4 L32's 'the running game / the test suite / the commit history / the one bug' each echo the immediately preceding chunks' own headers/content (1, 2, 1). No never-named, vague-with-history, or re-chunk-stranded referent found.

L23 'Same sizes as the prework' names the source document by title, not by page position (carve-out — navigational pointers, named not located; rule 2's own worked example is literally 'the prework' passing). No other cross-file references in body.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Every chunk (1-4) carries multiple self-carrying bullets or a standalone claim sentence (chunk 4, L32); none is a lone wait-state or context-dependent fragment.

Chunk 1 'Get to a running game' (L7) delivers build+play steps ending in a running game (L13); chunk 2 'Leave it with tests and a data surface' (L15) delivers tests (L17) and a data feature (L19); chunk 3 'Where the four task sizes come from' (L21) delivers the four sizes (L25-28); chunk 4 'Bring to Module 1' (L30) delivers the bring-list (L32). No header the chunk's content contradicts.

No 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction, no anaphora/epistrophe triples, no self-grading superlative, no number-with-retraction, no abstraction-noun stack, no hollow verb triplet found across all chunks (grepped body for 'one of the most', 'Not ', repeated sentence-initial anaphora — none present).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -n 'surface|compendium|forcing function|\bbeat\b|\bmood\b|firing|Connections' on body → only hits are 'surface area' (L12), 'a data surface' (header L15), 'no kind of surface' (L19 no-module branch), 'a user-facing surface' (L27) — all ordinary engineering usage of 'surface', explicitly the carved-out sense (not 'writing surface' as repo-dialect noun). No compendium/forcing-function/beat/mood/firing terms in body. 'STRIDE' and 'access-control surface' occur only below the maintainer cut (L46), outside the body region.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunks 0,1,2,4 carry zero bold.
